name: Åkulla - Ullared
description: Åkulla to Ullared. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
utilities: Stig mot Bockstens mosse och Bockstensmannen (service)
waterSources: Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort: Explicit official potable-water point for refilling bottles at Åkulla Outdoor Resort.
Dricksvatten Ullared: Official freshwater refill point near Gekåsbyn/Ullared camping.
Dricksvatten Åkulla Outdoor Resort: Official stage text says toilet and drinking water are available at Åkulla Outdoor Resort.
Dricksvatten Ullared: Official page says fresh water can be refilled at Gekåsbyn and Ullared camping. Verify open/access before import.

notes: Current Hallandsleden page/API/GPX are consistent for Åkulla - Ullared at 17 km / 16.9 km. Naturkartan slug and metadata, Hallandsleden API line.geometry, OSM relations and many third-party route listings still preserve older Åkulla-Kogstorp/Kogstorp-Kärnebygd segmentation.
Naturkartan page title says Åkulla - Ullared and site API shape mirrors official 16.857 km GPX, but visible metadata says length 11.0 km and difficulty red/krävande.

Official API line.geometry has 587 points and 11.033 km, ending near Kogstorp rather than Ullared. The same pattern appears in M2 where line.geometry starts near Kogstorp, indicating an old segmentation split.
English section page navigation says next section Ullared - Kvarnlyckan, while live official inventory and GPX use M2 Ullared - Kärnebygd.
English and Swedish/static snippets list some lodging options differently, including STF Bråtadal versus updated Swedish/service names.
Hallandstrafiken Åkulla page names line 651 stops Brännhult/Haksered and an approximately 600 m access distance, but measured endpoint distances to the M1 GPX start are about 3 km straight-line.

facilities.description: Land shelter/fireplace and Åkulla campsite/rest cluster near the stage start. Official pages also reference water/toilet context at Åkulla, but those services are better deduped to Åkulla Outdoor Resort and its explicit water point.

facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API / official place page
facilities.description: Primary Åkulla service node at the start with accommodation, food/drink, year-round toilet, drinking-water context and firewood context for nearby shelters. Opening hours and commercial access are dynamic.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Yasjön
facilities.coordinateSource: Hallandsleden places API / official place page
facilities.description: Island shelter in Yasjön near the Åkulla start cluster. Access is by cable ferry/raft; access to the island is prohibited during the bird nesting period 1 March-30 June and the raft normally operates from 1 July to mid-October. Firewood should be brought or bought at Åkulla Outdoor Resort.
